Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                             ORDINANCE


BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:


SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance,

be amended by changing all the B3-1 Community Shopping District

symbols and indications as shown on Map No.9-M in the area bounded by

       West Cornelia Avenue; North Central Avenue; a line 206.80 feet south of
       and parallel to North Comelia Avenue; and Public Alley west of and
       parallel to North Central Avenue;

to those ofa B2-2 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District is hereby established in the

area above described.


SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and

due publication.



Common Address of Property:         3438-58 N. Central Avenue
